stage2.category_allowlist_note: PROVISIONAL (engineer, 2026-11-07, for Yonatan's review). Hebrew Maps items return no category_ids, only localized category text, so spec 8's text fallback is used: ids are categoryId(text) from config/market-scanner/category-catalog.json, matched against category + additional_categories. roofing = waterproofing service, waterproofing company, roofer (excluded: general contractor, plumber, renovator, insulation contractor, building-materials stores). pergolas = pergola/carport manufacturer, awning supplier, patio-enclosure supplier, aluminum supplier, fence contractor (the last two kept because most Karmiel listings in them carry a pergola term in the name; excluded: carpentry, aluminum windows, garden designer, construction company).
